anomalies.observed: C21 is annotated with value "10n" (10 nF), but its library part, footprint, PN and description all describe a 10 µF 16 V X5R 0805 ceramic (GRM21BR61C106KE15L). The 10 nF value is also carried into the SPICE deck. The +5V rail therefore has a 10 nF decoupler whose record says it is 10 µF.
anomalies.expected: A +5V decoupling capacitor whose value, footprint and part number agree. Either a 10 µF part (matching the other +5V decoupling caps C15/C16 at 10 µF) or a 10 nF part in a matching 0603 footprint.
anomalies.impact: If the 10 nF value is what was built, the +5V rail (ESP32 5V0 input and the AZ1117 input) has much less local bulk/decoupling than the design intends, which can reduce stability margin and increase ripple or transient droop on the 5 V rail.
